sanskrit: kalpavṛkṣaśamīvṛkṣevaṭacaṃpakapippalaiḥ mahāsadasisauvarṇe sarvavarṇapariṣkṛte āsīnaṃ parameśānaṃ avāṅmanasagocaram sarvavidyāvidhātāraṃ vāme gaurisamāyutam sastūyamānaṃ devādyaiḥ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥ maheśvara prasannātmā śivajñānaṃ jighṛllayā devadeva jagannātha bhaktānāmārlināśanaḥ śaivāntamārṇavāntajña jñānaraktapradarśakaḥ bhaktyā ca parayāyuktaparasaṃvitsvarūpayā sādhakānaṃ hitaṃ puṇyaṃ yogināṃ mokṣasādhanam evaṃ pṛṣṭhomaheśena bhagavān parameśvaraḥ vakṣye saṃkṣepamārgeṇa yathāpraśnaṃ tathepsitam śivajñānaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ bhogamokṣapradaṃ śubham yuktaṃ śatasahasreṇa granthe sarvārthasādhakam tat tu saṃkṣepatastubhyaṃ adhunā saṃpravakṣyate ūrdhvaśaivaṃ tu prathamaṃ ādiśaivaṃ dvitīyakam avāntaraṃ pañcamaṃ ca miśraṃ caiva tu ṣaṣṭhakam ājñāśaivaṃ tu navamaṃ śaivabhedakramaṃ śṛṇu teṣu śreṣṭhatamaṃ śaiva mūrdhvasrotassamudbhavam saumyaṃ ca dvividhaṃ proktaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ caiva miśrakam viparītaṃ tu vāmaṃ syāt dvayormiśraṃ tu saṅgamam vedāntārthamayaṃ jñānaṃ siddhāntaṃ paramaṃ śubham vedasārārthadaṃ jñeyaṃ anyatvanyārthasādhanam nāmabhiḥ kāmikādistu vakṣyate kramaśaḥ śṛṇu trāṇaṃ ca kurute puṃsāṃ tena tantramiti smṛtam

dīptaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sahasraṃ ca aṃśumān su prabhedakam vīraṃ ca rauravaṃ caiva makuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathā siddhaṃ santānasaṃjñaṃ ca śarvoktaṃ pārameśvaram eteṣu pūrvadaśakaṃ śivabhedaṃ prakīrtitam śivarudrātmakaṃ tantraṃ aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyakam atha siddhāntatantrāṇāṃ śrotāraṃ tu viśeṣataḥ śrotāraśśivabhedānāṃ pāraṃparyāstrayastrayaḥ praṇavastrikalāstryakṣaḥ sudhākhyo bhasmako vibhuḥ śarvarudraḥ prajeśaśca subhuḥ śivaśivo'cyutaḥ tato vai śravaṇaścaiva prabhaṃ ca jñābhidhāyakaḥ ravirvighneśvaścaiva dadhīśaḥ śivanāmakaḥ anādiḥ parameśaśca daśārṇo girijā tataḥ tejaḥ prajāpatiścaiva prameṇaścena naghnakaḥ ananto bṛhaspatiścaiva praśāntaścadadhīcakaḥ binduḥ caṇḍeśvaraścaiva śivaniṣṭho savoplavaḥ devapītā ca saṃvartnaḥ śivo mahākālastathā mūlatantropabhedāśca vakṣyate nāmabhiḥ kramāt ṣaḍbhedaṃ cintya tantraṃ ca saptabhedaṃ tu kāraṇam sūkṣmamekavidhaṃ proktaṃ daśabhedaṃ sahasrakam aṣṭabhedaṃ tu vijayaṃ niśvāsaṃ cāṣṭabhedakam vīratantraṃ viśeṣeṇa bhedāścaiva trayodaśa vimalaṃ tu kalābhedaṃ candrajñāne caturdaśa lalitaṃ guṇabhedaṃ syāt siddhaṃ ca yugabhedakam parameśaṃ saptabhedaṃ kiraṇaṃ navabhedakam nārasiṃhaṃ ca vaktāraṃ bhairavottarameva ca

ātmayogaṃ sṛtāraṃ ca ditiṃ yogantu pañcamam parodbhavayya cintyasya bhedāṣaṭkīrtitāḥ kramāt vidveṣaṃ māraṇaṃ caiva saptabhedāstu kāraṇe ajitasya caturbhedāḥ paścādabjamasaṃkhyakam adbhutaṃ mādhavodbhūtaṃ dīpta tantreṇa vismṛtāḥ atītaṃ maṅgalaṃ śuddhaṃ aprameyantu jātibhāk rāte sahasra tantrasya daśabhedā udāhṛtāḥ bhūtatantraṃ prakaraṇaṃ vidyāpurāṇameva ca ātmālaṃkārakaṃ brahma daśāṃśumato hitaḥ mahāghoramaghoraṃ ca vimalaṃ mṛtyunāśanam niśvāsaṃ mantraniśvāsaṃ niśvāsottarasaṃjñikāḥ niśvāsanayanaṃ caiva syānniśvāsamukhodayam prājāpatyaṃ ca padmaṃ ca dvayaṃ svāyaṃbhuve smṛtam bodhaṃ prabodhaṃ śakaṭaṃ bodhakaṃ prastaraṃ halam tathaiva phullanayanaṃ mohasaṃbhavameva ca kāladāhaṃ kalātītaṃ rauravaṃ rauravottaram dvau bhedau makuṭe proktau mākuṭaṃ mākuṭottaram sudantamatibhūtaṃ ca raudraṃ bhadravitaṃ tathā anantamaṭṭahāsākhyaṃ accitaṃ māraṇaṃ tathā rākapādapurāṇaṃ ca sthāṇvākhyaṃ nandikeśvaram kalpabhedamitivyāptaṃ mahāvāruṇameva ca śivaśekharamityuktaṃ candrajñānecaturdaśa arthālaṅkāramaiśānaṃ tauṭikantu niṭīrakam mahāvidyāmahāsauraṃ naiṛtaṃ paṭṭaśekharam varāhaṃ pāśabandhaṃ ca piṅgalāmanameva ca

vijñānamāyurvedaṃ ca śrīkālajñānasaṃjñakam bharataṃ gītavātodyaṃ prodgīte ṣoḍaśasmṛtāḥ kaumāraṃ tataḥ śālabhedaṃ sārottarāhvayam siddhatantrasya catvāro bhedāstu parikīrtitāḥ asaṅkhyamaniladvandvaṃ santāne saptabhedakaḥ vāyuproktaṃ kuberākhyaṃ śarvokte pañcadhā smṛtāḥ puṣkaraṃ suprayogaṃ ca saptadhā parameśvare prabuddhaṃ henukaṃ kālaṃ kiraṇe navakīrtitāḥ sarvaṃ ca kālajñānaṃ ca nityaṃ sarvārthakaṃ tathā vātulākhye mahātantre bhedāḥ dvādaśakīrtitāḥ kāmikādyajitāntāstu sadyojāta mukhodbhavāḥ vijayādyāstu vīrāntāḥ saṃhitā ghoravaktrajāḥ īśānavaktrasaṃjātāḥ prodgītādyāṣṭasaṃhitāḥ parārdhaṃ kāmikaṃ proktaṃ yogajaṃ lakṣamucyate ajitaṃ tvayutaṃ proktaṃ niyutaṃ dīptamucyate aṃśumān pañcalakṣaṃ tu suprabhedaṃ trikoṭikam svāyambhuvaṃ trikoṭyardhaṃ analaṃtvayutatrayam makuṭaṃ śatasāhasraṃ vimalaṃ ca trilakṣakam prodgītaṃ trilakṣaṃ syāt lalitaṃ cāṣṭasahasrakam śarvodgītaṃ dvilakṣaṃ syāt pārameśa dvilakṣakam tantramūrtiñca saṃkṣepāt pravakṣyāmi maheśvara cintyaṃ pādāṅgulaṃ proktaṃ jaṃghā yugmaṃ tu kāraṇam sūkṣmaṃ ca guhyabījaṃ syāt sahasraṃ tu kaṭītalam vijayaṃ kukṣadeśaṃ syāt niśvāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhavet vīraṃ ca karṇadeśaṃ tu rauravaṃ śravaṇadvayam

bahna tu vimalaṃ proktaṃ candrajñāna muṭasthalam kapolaṃ lalitaṃ proktaṃ siddhaṃ caiva lalāṭakam pārameśaṃ ca hārastu kiraṇaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam vātulaṃ vasanaṃ proktaṃ śiva dharmonulepanam tantrātmakena kāyena devaṃ dakṣiṇatomukham dhyāyet sidhyai gururnityaṃ sandhyākāle viśeṣataḥ anyeṣāṃ procyate nātra granthavistāraśaṃkayā kṛtaṃ cedupabhedena kartā bhartā vinaśyati pratiṣṭhādyaistu mūlaiśca ṣaṭṣaṣṭhakathitairvanam tena sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ na kuryādanyatantrataḥ śivasiddhānta tantreṇa prārabdhaṃ karṣaṇādikam tantra saṅkaradoṣeṇa rājarāṣṭaṃ ca naśyati anyeṣāṃ svasvatantreṇa vidyā tatvedhikāritā mahāpādakadoṣaghnaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradāyakam gurudehe śubheliṅge sthaṇḍile ca nijātmani nirmitaṃ vidhinā liṅgaṃ surairvā munibhirvaraiḥ parārthe tu samākhyātāḥ sarveṣāmātmanāṃ phalam vipra kṣatriya viṭcchūdrā dīkṣitāśca praveśakāḥ ūrdhvaśaivena kartavyaṃ ātmārthaṃ ca parārthakam nirvāṇadīkṣitānāṃ tu ātmārthaṃ ca parārthakam makuṭaṃ tu paraṃ nāma paratāṇḍavakīrtanam antyajātesu dīkṣāyāṃ abhicārāya kalpate grāmasyaiśānyadigbhāge malādīni visarjayet brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ nṝṇāṃ strīṇāṃ cānyatra sannidheḥ rāvaṃ mala visarge tu śepho hastaṃ praveśayet

nadyāṃ taṭāke kūpe vā śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi astramantreṇa nāsāsya dantaśuddhiṃ samācaret malasnānaṃ purā kṛtvā mantrasnānavidhiṃ śṛṇu vāruṇaṃ taijasaṃ divyaṃ vāyavyaṃ mānasaṃ tathā vṛṣṭyā sādapyā dinyāṃ vāyavyaṃ rajasāṃ gavām nadyāṃ vāpi taṭākāṃ vā kūpe vā tīrthavāri ca śivaliṅgeti te vidyācchivapādaprasecanāt kuryāddhastapramāṇena maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakam sadyena sthāpayet tatra vāmamantreṇa śodhayet pūrveṇa dakṣiṇenaivā tathā vai cottareṇa tu ṣaḍaṅgaṃ brahma japtvā tu pūrvādibhyo nyaset kramāt sadyojāta mṛdābhogaṃ stīrthamadhye vinikṣipet ṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ nyastvā svanāmādyena lekhayet jale sūkṣmāśca ye doṣāḥ teṣāmuccāṭanaṃ bhavet pūrvavat sthāpyamṛtpiṇḍaṃ sarvāṅgañca vilepayet brahmāgniṃ pitṛdevarṣitīrthāni kramaśaḥ śṛṇu āgneyaṃ paitṛkaṃ paścāt tarjanyaṅguṣṭha madhyataḥ aṅgulyagre tīrthamārṣaṃ pañcadevāṃstu vinyaset sparśanaṃ pitṛtīrthena daivatīrthena mārjanam rājopacārasahitaṃ sugandhāmalakādibhiḥ jalāvagahanānte tu divyastrīparisevitam aṅgairvyomavyāpinā ca tyambakākhyādimantrataḥ abhiṣekaṃ śanairmūrdhni vidadhyādvaktramudrayā dakṣapādasthale kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ jalepi ca māṣamātra pramāṇena jalānāṃ prāśanaṃ bhavet

mukha hastena saṃspṛśya pādāvabhyukṣayet punaḥ aṅguṣṭha tarjanyagrāhyā sparśennāsāpuṭadvayam aṅguṣṭhamadhyamāgrābhyāṃ bāhyoyugmaṃ punaspṛśet evaṃ kṛtvā tu mantrajña pratyaṅgamupasaṃspṛśet atharveṇetihāsena vaktrasaṃsparśanaṃ dvidhā mūrdhānaṃ cākṣuṣī śrotre sarvādityendra tṛptaye punarācamanaṃ cāpi tanmantrairevamācaret śivamantrābhiṣekaṃ tu pādamudrātvanantaram puruṣāṇāṃ ca sāvitrī mṛṣṭottaraśataṃ japet pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca vyomavyāpi triyaṃbakam sandhyāṃ caivā tu sāvitrīṃ gāyatrīṃ sarvadevatām sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamedbhūmau namonama iti bruvan devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva vāmaghorājaśambaraiḥ pitṝṇāmapitīrthena vidadhyāt tarpaṇaṃ kramāt śrīrudraṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca pañcabrahma ṣaḍaṅgakam tīrthaṃ saṃharaṇaṃ kuryāt astrapañjaramadhyagam darbhadvayena vā darbhaistribhirvā pañcabhistu vā agraṃ vai caturaṅgulyaṃ grandhiścandrāṅgulismṛtaḥ granthibrahmādhidaivatyo rajjurviṣṇvadhidaivataḥ agraṃ rudrādhidaivatyaṃ pavitrasyādhidevatāḥ prakṣālyapādāvācamya bhasmasnānamathācaret apamṛtyupraśamanaṃ śivamārogyavardhanam sarvadevātmakau śuddhaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam yathā goṣu viśeṣeṇa tadutpattividhiṃ śṛṇu dīpaṃ ca sadgopādeṣu praṇamya pratipādayet

tāmbūlaṃ dāpayitvā tu gosāvitrīṃ śataṃ japet * * * * * * * * (?) tannogāvaḥ pracodayāt karābhyāṃ padmapatraṃ ca bilvapatraṃ ca dhārayet piṇḍī kuryācca vāmena ghoramantreṇa śoṣayet ketakīmallikānāṃ ca caṃpakaṃ pāṭalaṃ tathā jātiñca tatra nikṣipya sadbhāṇḍeṣu parigrahet tadbhasmaṃ parigṛhṇīta śivamantramanusmaran dakṣajānuni saṃsthāpya śivamantraṃ śataṃ japet hṛdayaṃ ghoramantreṇa guhyaṃ vai vāmamantrataḥ jalasnānaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantrairetaistu valitam pāṇipādau ca saṃśodhya kuryādācamanaṃ punaḥ dehevalāṃchanaṃ kuryāt bhasmabhirmiśracandanaiḥ adīkṣitaṃ tripuṇḍrasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate śṛṇu vaiśyānāṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ śūdrāṇāmekamaṅgulam nṛpāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca bhasmamiśritacandanam lalāṭe bāhuyugme ca hṛdaye ca tripuṇḍrakam saṃdhārya karayugme ca viśuddhaṃ bhasmadeśikaḥ brahmāviṣṇuścarudraśca tripuṇḍrasyādhidevatāḥ urasthale ca bāhau tu nābhau pṛṣṭhe tathaiva ca brahmarandhre svayaṃ brahmā subrahmaṇyo lalāṭake bāhvorindraśca viṣṇuśca hṛdaye ca tatheśvaraḥ ūrudvaye tu nābhaiśca nāgakanyāstathaiva ca pādayorarṇavāssapta sarvatīrthāni ca sthitāḥ ṣoḍaśākṣara mantrantu tattatsthāneṣu vinyaset āsanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvitīyaṃ cākṣamālikā

kamaṇḍaluḥ pañcamaṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ syāduttarīyakam pavitraṃ navamaṃ caiva daśamaṃ bhasmakīrtitam trayodaśaṃ mṛdgrahaṇaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak khādiraṃ campakaṃ caiva candanaṃ vilvameva ca dvitālastasya vistāraṃ samutsedhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulam darpaṇodarasaṅkāśaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāga samāḥ padāḥ japamālābhuromālāṃ śiromālāṃ tathā punaḥ pañcaviṃśati rudrākṣaiḥ mumukṣūṇāṃ japasmṛtaḥ saptaviṃśati bhuktyarthaṃ puṣṭyarthamaṣṭāviṃśatiḥ itthaṃ tu japamālāsyā danyānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu śiromālā tu tannābhā bāhumālā ca tatsamā darśanaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ sparśanaṃ sarvasiddhidam śucirvāpya śucirvāpi rudrākṣaṃ dhārayet sadā sa rudrapadamāpnoti kiṃ punurmānuṣādayaḥ dhāraṇāt svargamāpnoti punarjanma na vidyate divyavarṣa sahasraṃ tu cakṣurunmīlitaṃ mayā dhārayaṃ mriyate yastu sa yāti paramāṃgatim caturvaktraṃ tu bindu syāt pañcavaktraṃ sadāśivaḥ viṣṇuścaivāṣṭavaktraṃ tu navavaktraṃ caturmukhaḥ hastakaṇṭha śikhākarṇa yajñasūtreṣu sarvadā rājāvārtā vaṇigvārtā lokavārtā viśeṣataḥ rudrākṣāṇāṃ sahasreṇa kalpitāṃ śivarūpiṇām tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rudrākṣaistu sadā japet viprāṇāṃ mastakotsedhaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vakṣasassamam daṇḍameva vidhiṃ proktaṃ yogapaṭṭamidaṃ śṛṇu

vistāraṃ tryaṅgulastasyamānaṃ syādupavītavat āḍhakā pūritaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ triprasthapūritam sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ athavā mṛṇmayaṃ tu vā uttarīyaṃ tathoṣṇīṣaṃ śuddhavastreṇa kārayet upavītaṃ cottarīyaṃ hṛnmantreṇaiva dhārayet āsanaṃ vasanaṃ cārghya gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam aṣṭāṅgasahitaṃ nityaṃ pūjayeddakṣiṇeśvaram śālyantaṃ caiva valyantaṃ pūjā trividhamucyate caturbhiraṅgaissidhyarthaṃ pādyamevamudāhṛtam takkolaṃ caiva kuṇḍaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva pāṭalam kuśāgraṃ jīramāpaśca yavaṃ siddhārthameva ca arghyaṃ daśāṃśamityuktaṃ gandhadravyavidhiṃ śṛṇu tadardhaṃ pādamātraṃ vā karpūreṇa samanvitam dhavalāruṇa kṛṣṇāni sātvikādi guṇatraye tāni sarvāṇi kathyante tāmasāni maheśvara tāmasaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaṃ tu pītapuṣpaṃ tu śobhanam nandyāvartaṃ ca punnāgaṃśvetārkamudaye dadet droṇapuṣpaṃ tu madhyāhne viśeṣeṇa nivedayet jātīkena kadaṃ bāhyo niyojyāvardharātrake apakva matipakvaṃ ca mukulīkutsitaṃ tathā svayaṃpatita puṣpāṇi paryuṣitāni varjayet puṣpajātiṣu sarveṣu giripuṣpaṃ viśeṣataḥ prakṣālya parameśānaṃ arcayecca punaḥ punaḥ apāmārgaśśamī caiva dalatācāmalīkarī evaṃ patrāṇi mukhyāni kīrtitāni viśeṣataḥ

patraṃ brahmapriyaṃ proktaṃ puṣpaṃ viṣṇupriyaṃ tathā saṅgṛhet śivapūjārthaṃ patrapuṣpaphalādikam itthaṃ puṣpavidhi prokto dīpasyavidhirucyate catustridvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ dīpajvālāviśiṣyate **(?) ca kṛtyaṃ tu tadvakṣye śṛṇuṣvekaṃ maheśvara tṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhiḥsyāt caturthaṃ liṅgaśodhanam uttarābhimukho maunī baddhayogāsanasthiraḥ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryāt pratyekaṃ daśamātrikam recakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca tridhā matam candrārkacaritaṃ yasya mṛtakaṃ sūtakāśritam dvaye ***(?) ye dvāyuṃ nāsikā maṇḍaladvayam sūtakaṃ pretakaṃ śrutvā pūjāhomaṃ na kārayet tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kuru candrārkanāśanam ūrdhvavaktraṃ tu jihvāgraṃ suṣuṃnādvārabandhanam kumbhakaṃ prāṇanirataṃ maunakarmanirantaram mṛtakaṃ sūtakaṃ tyaktvā yāvannirṇayamucyate āvāhanāsanantasya mātrādvādaśakaṃ bhavet ekamātraṃ bhavedarghyaṃ ṣaṇmātraṃ gandhadāpanam dīpadānaṃ tu ṣaṇmātraṃ baliṣṣoḍaśamātrikaḥ snānaṃ vastraṃ copavītaṃ trayaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi mātrābhiraṣṭādhikyena śatena sahato japaḥ devaprītikaraṃ tena sarvaṃ sādhanamucyate pūjayet sarvakāleṣu dine rātrau na sā kriyā candrārkanāśanādeva pūjāsiddhaṃ maheśvara jānvādi pādaparyantaṃ pṛthivīsthānamucyate

ākārākṣaramārabhya prānte tvatkāramālikhet hakārādīnibījāni kṣakārāntāni deśikaḥ itthamakṣararūpeṇa dhyātvā dakṣiṇatomukham dhyāyeddevaṃ tu manasā karapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu brahmamudrāṃ purā kṛtvā vahnibījena śodhayet aṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ īśānādīnkramānyaset karābhyāṃ mantramudrāṃ ca mahānādaṃ tu bandhayet aṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsa ucyate vānaprastha yatīnāṃ ca saṃhāranyāsa ucyate nyasocaṃ vānaprasthasya pūrvoktavidhinā tataḥ akārādi kṣakārāntaṃ aṅguṣṭhādi kramānyaset mūlaprakṛtikānnyastvā yathāpūrvanyaset tataḥ śivamantraṃ sakṛjjaptvā vadhnīyādbrahmamudrikām mūlabījamanusmṛtya likhitvā varṇamākṛtam varṇamantraṃ viśeṣaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara cavargāntaṃ tṛtīyādi vapūrvāntaṃ samuccaran hāntaṃ kāntaṃ sakārāntaṃ kramādeva samuccaret bindunāda samāyuktaṃ varṇamantramidaṃ śubham akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasye ākāraṃ tu lalāṭake ukāraṃ dakṣanāsāyāṃ ūkāraṃ vāmake puṭe ḷkāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe ḹkāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake oṅkāra mūrdhvadante tu aukāraṃ daśaneṣvadhaḥ kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste cavargaṃ vāmahastake ṣaṣṭhau ca dakṣiṇe pārśve babhau vai vāmapārśvake rephaṃ raktapradeśe tu lakāraṃ māṃsadeśake

majjādeśe kṣakāraṃ tu sakāraṃ śukladeśake kakāraṃ meḍhradeśe tu kṣakāraṃ vṛṣaṇe nyaset dvādaśaṃ bījamuccārya mūlamantraṃ samuccaret pañcabrahmākṛtiṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara hārake pūrakaṭakaṃ kuṇḍalābharaṇojvalam kheṭaṭaṃka samāyuktaṃ varadābhayapāṇikam vāmadevodbhavaṃ raktaṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujam pravālamakuṭaṃ caiva hemayajñopavītakam triṇetraṃ trivilāsaṃ ca karṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitam aghoraṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ bhīmaṃ bhinnāñjana samaprabham raktāmbaradharaṃ caiva raktavastrottarīyakam śūlavetāla khaḍgāṃśca cakraṃ dakṣadharodadhat nīlāṅgulīyakaṃ caiva nāgayajñopavītakam pūruṣaṃ kuṅkumākāraṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujam trikoṇaṃ saumyavaktraṃ tu kiñcitprahasitānanam muktāphalakirīṭaṃ ca māṇikkādaṅgulīyakam daśabāhuṃ triṇetraṃ ca pañcavaktraṃ jaṭādharam pāśāṅkuśaṃ ḍamarukaṃ dadhānaṃ vāmapāṇibhiḥ saumyaṃ sphaṭikavarṇābhaṃ īśamūrtisvarūpakam taṃ brahmarūpasaumyaṃ tat paramaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇam vāmaṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sthitikāraṇameva ca sadāśivaṃ tathaiśānaṃ mahāmokṣapradāyakam kalā devamayā śreṣṭhāḥ kalāmantraśca tāntrikam kalābrahmavadākārā kanyākārāstu śaktayaḥ sarvābharaṇa saṃpūrṇā makuṭairupaśobhitā

sarvamantrātmakaṃ mantraṃ piṇḍamantramidaṃ śubham liṅgabhedakramaṃ vakṣye viśeṣaṃ tu yathākramam calaliṅge sadāvāsaṃ pūjayet parameśvaram mantrasaṃskārahīne tu liṅgamākṛti mātrakam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena svāmirūpaṃ sadārcayet satyavastu svarūpaṃ tu paraṃ sādākhya tat **(?) pūrvākṛtiṃ parityajya sādākhyākṛtireva ca nṛttarūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā dakṣiṇālayamādikaḥ navatatvamayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ param śubhaṃ paramanirvāṇaṃ sarvadeha sadāśivam hṛtpadmamadhye saṃsthāpya nādatantraṃ kalāmayam āsīnaṃ vā sunṛttaṃ vā dhyāyennityaṃ maheśvara aṅguṣṭhamātramacalaṃ śuddhatatvaṃ navātmakam ātmānaṃ tu sakārasyaṃ antarātmā tu bindukaḥ sarvaṃ hṛdayamantreṇa pūjayitvā yathākramam aṣṭatriṃśatparaṃ nṛttaṃ nyāsakālakramaṃ śṛṇu aṣṭatriṃ* * * * * * (?)ṣṭatriṃśātmamantrakam dehaśuddhiṃ kalānyāsaṃ aṣṭatriṃśātmamantrakam ātmaśuddhikramaṃ proktaṃ sthānaśuddhikramaṃ śṛṇu ****(?)kṣya bahudhā loṣṭāsthyādīni varjayet vitāna dhvajasaṃyuktaṃ kadalīkramukānvitam puṣpamālā samākīrṇaṃ dīpamālā pariṣkṛtam śuddhodakena saṃpūrya sauranyāsaṃ samācaret sthale pṛṣṭhe ca saṃśodhya karayordakṣavāmayoḥ praṇavaṃ vahni saṃyuktaṃ *(?) kārāntāntamakṣaram

vyomapūrvaṃ visargāntaṃ sūryamantraṃ namontakam arkāya śirase nyasya bhūrbhuvasva śikhānyaset agnibījaṃ visargāntaṃ saurāstraṃ dik ca saṃyutam abindumekamuccārya polkasūryāntamuccaran kuśākṣatenayūpāntaṃ arcayedraktacandanam ekavaktraṃ dvibāhuṃ ca dvinetraṃ ghṛtapaṅkajam sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam caturvaktramaṣṭabāhuṃ dhyāyeddivasanāyakam saptāśvarathamārūḍhaṃ prabhākaravibhākaram medhā prajñā samāyuktaṃ somādigrahasaṃyutam rāhuḥ ketuṃ kramādete grahā mṛtyuvināśanāḥ śyāmavarṇo budhaprokto nīlavarṇobṛhaspatiḥ kākameghanibhorāhuḥ ketu dhūmrābha ucyate sarvābharaṇasaṃpūrṇā dvibhujāśca prakīrtitāḥ aṅkārakaṃ yāmyabhāge paścime tu bṛhaspatim ketuṃ ca naiṛte bhāge vinyasedbudhamānile prabhāmuṣāṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca prajñāṃ caiva tu vinyaset athāṣṭhau lokapālāṃśca tattatsthāneṣu pūjayet ṣaḍaṅganyāsamaṃbhasya arghyaṃ caiva pradāpayet pañcaprākāranāmāni śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara madhyahāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ syāt madhyādi ca caturthakam eteṣāmāyamānaṃ ca prākārāṇāṃ śṛṇu kramāt antarhārakamekaṃ tu madhyahāraṃ dvidaṇḍikā kūpasthānaṃ tṛtīyasya prākārasyadikīśituḥ āgneya yāmyayormadhye vastraśālāsamīritā

mahāmaryādikaiśānyaṃ mahāmaṇṭapamucyate prākāramaṇṭapaṃ proktaṃ dvārapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu sopānaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve kundendu ca samaprabham kambugrīvaṃ varapradaṃ hastivaktramanantaram varṇaśca daśavighnānāṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak dhūmraṃ svarṇaṃ bālasūryaṃ mauktikaṃ puṣparāgakam uttare ca kapāṭasya devatā viṣṇurucyate dakṣiṇe tu kapāṭasya śikhā bhṛṅgīśa devatā paṭṭikānāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ subrahmaṇyo maheśvaraḥ astramantreṇa saṃprokṣya suṣiraṃ bandhayet tataḥ gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca havirādadet kapāṭaṃ daṇḍamadhyasthau aṣṭaparvatadevatāḥ kapāṭavāsi devāṃśca pūjayet svasvanāmabhiḥ vāyumantreṇa yantrāṇāṃ calanaṃ kārayet tataḥ dakṣiṇe dvāradevānāṃ gandharvāyakṣarākṣasāḥ uttaradvāradevānāṃ ṣaṭkāroṃkāravyāhṛtiḥ pārśve tu dakṣiṇe devo śivajyotiṣanāmakaḥ dakṣiṇadvāradevānāṃ jñānadrutaguṇāya ca uttaradvāradevānāṃ abhayāya guṇāya ca pārśve tu dakṣiṇe devīṃ vīrabhadraṃ prapūjayet dakṣiṇadvāradevānāṃ mārutodaityadānavāḥ uttaradvāradevānāṃ madbhūtānalarudrakāḥ dakṣiṇe pārśvadevānāṃ nīlalohitadevatā dakṣiṇedvāradevānāṃ śivānandāvṛtāya ca uttaradvāradevānāṃ īśānāṃ devatāpurāḥ

anyarthaṃ sarvaniṣṭhāthīdaṃgajālayamāṣakam dhṛtiśaktisadacchāyā **(?) sphaṭikaliṅgakam nāgaśaktīti sadanaṃ drāviḍaṃ vardhamānakam sadanaṃ liṅgaśaktīnāṃ jīvaprāṇavyavasthitam tasmāt sarvātmamadhyasthaṃ jyotirūpaṃ naṭaṃ gurum śaṅkhakāhalavallaryaiḥ ghaṇṭāghoṣaiḥ sunūpuraḥ sadanaṃ liṅgamadhyasthaṃ arcayettu naṭeśvaram liṅgamantraṃ samuccārya tanmantroddhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu liṅgamantramiti proktaṃ śaktīnāṃ sthānamucyate jagatībhūtaśaktistu kumudaṃ guṇaśaktikam adhaḥpaṭṭī tu kāmādhī mahāpaṭṭīmanonmanī stambhaṃ tu nādaśaktiśca padmaṃ bhairavaśaktikam karṇikāmayinī śaktiḥ vabiṇyo uśoṣaṇīyakam mahānāsī tadutsedhaṃ śikharaṃ navaśaktikam karṇaṃ ca karuṇāśaktiḥ kumbhākṣīrāmanīyakam kambukānādaśaktiśca malakaṃ mantraśaktikam itthaṃ śaktyātmakaṃ dhāma proktaṃ sakalarūpakam jyotiprabhāsu madhyasthaṃ naṭaṃ dakṣiṇamadbhutam parāśaktiparaṃ nṛttaṃ vaidikaṃ dakṣiṇeśvaram prāsādaṃ dakṣiṇeśānaṃ pavitraṃ prabhumādikam sadānandamayaṃ sāmbaṃ sākṣisādāśivaṃ gurum samaṃ samarasībhāvaṃ viśvatomukhamūrdhvakam kaṇṭhāt prabhṛtivasvaśraṃ prāsādaṃ drāvikaṃ bhavet trivargaṣṣaṇṇavatīnānāṃ nāmavakṣye maheśvara sarvato bhadraṃ caiva hasti pṛṣṭhaṃ samujvalam

pañcabhūtādhidaivatyaṃ pañcabrahmasvarūpakam ityetairlakṣaṇairyuktaṃ sādākhyaṃ tu svarūpakam vahniruṣṇatvavacchaktirapināhāvinīvibhoḥ * * (?) na śaktikopetātvākhyayā tu manonmanī lokapālāssaśastrāśca kramaśastassamudbhavāḥ sarvāvayava saṃpūrṇāstvanantāditya sa prabhā tatsādākhya prabhāvastu varṇitaṃ naiva śakyate mūrtayastvīśvarādyāśca sakalaṃ iti kīrtitāḥ brahmādyāvaraṇaṃ caiva pūrvavat parikalpayet vidyātatva sthitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutam liṅgapūjāvasāne tu pūjayedīśvaraṃ kramāt caturbhuja triṇetrastu candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ īśvarasya tu koṭyaṃśāt brahmatatva samudbhavaḥ kamaṇḍalvakṣamālāsṛk pītavarṇa sulocanaḥ rudraḥ saṃhāramūrtīnāṃ viṣṇuśca sthitimūrtikaḥ mūrtitrayastu saṃproktaṃ brahmāṇḍe saṃvyavasthitam bhogasthānaṃ tu sakalaṃ layādhikārabhogavān sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva tvaparaṃ paripaṭhyate tisṛstu devatāḥ paścāt trayastriṃśat samudbhavāḥ vasavoṣṭāśvinau dvau tu trayastriṃśaccadevatāḥ śarīraṃ bhūtasāreṇa devānāṃ tu sṛjanti vai sarvakāraṇa deveśa dhyātvā tāṇḍavamīśvaram mūlaṃ smṛtvā paraṃ dhyātvā sarvavyāpi sadāśivaḥ sthāpanaṃ vāmamantreṇa tvaghoreṇa nirodhayet

yathā kuṇḍagataścāgnirvāyunā paridīpyate āvāhyānākhyayāvāhyasthāpinyā sthāpyamudrayā niṣṭhunā liṅgamādrāṃ ca padmanetrāstramudrikā gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayet liṅgamūlaṃ tu caraṇau liṅgāgraṃ mukhamucyate īśvarāddakṣiṇāṃśe tu brahmā sṛṣṭhyarthamudyataḥ nāsāyāṃ vāyurutpanna śrotrayostu diśodaśa hṛdayeṣāṃ mukho jāto bhāskaro nābhisaṃbhavaḥ vāmanetrasudbhūto devassoma iti smṛtaḥ hastāgrādāyudhodbhūti ratyāścaiva nakhodbhavāḥ pādayossarvadevānāṃ śivajñānasya codbhavaḥ liṅgamūrti svarūpasya madhye sādākhyamarcayet pañcāsya pañcamūrdhānaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanam aṣṭaśrotra dvipādaṃ ca kiñcit prahasitānanam cakraṃ ca jñānamudrāṃ ca savyabhāge bhayaṃ kramāt varadaṃ vismayaṃ caiva vibhrāṇaṃ vāmapāṇibhiḥ sadyavāmādi mantreṇa sthāpayet pūrvavat śubham vaktreṣu vaktramantreṇa dadyādācamanīyakam mukheṣu gandhaṃ vāmena puṣpamīśena mūrdhasu naivedyaṃ vaktramantreṇa kramāddadyānmaheśvara pañcabrahma ṣaḍaṅgaiśca kalpayeddhenumudraya vāruṇaṃ bījamuccārya jalabhāṇḍe tu pūjayet caturdikṣu catuṣkoṇeṣvācamārghyaṃ pradāpayet kṣīraṃ tu rudradaivatyaṃ maheśoṃ dadhi cocyate pañcasāre tu naivedyaṃ darśayedjñānamudrikām

pañcagavyaṃ kramaṃ proktaṃ phalodaka vidhiṃ śṛṇu āmra kelīphalaṃ phalaṃ caiva tintriṇīvaphalodakam phalodaka vidhiṃ prokto bījodakavidhiṃ śṛṇu saugandhikaṃ hemaśālī bījodakamidaṃ śubham bījodakavidhi proktaṃ ratnodakavidhiṃ śṛṇu pravālaṃ sphaṭikaṃ nīlaṃ muktā ratnodakaṃ śubham itthaṃ ratnodakaṃ proktaṃ gandhodakavidhiṃ śṛṇu karpūraṃ pichilā caiva kastūrī cāgarustathā gandhādikaṃ tu naivedyaṃ nāmamantreṇa dāpayet caṃpaka prasavaṃ caiva mallikā caiva pāṭalī nandyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ mandāraṃ karavīrakam gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca śivamantreṇa dāpayet athānnairabhiṣekaṃ tu āyurārogyavardhanam tasmādannābhiṣekaṃ tu mamaprītikaraṃ śubham annapūjāvidhiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nabhūtanna bhaviṣyati annaliṅgākṛtiṃ datvā gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam annapūjāvidhiṃ nityaṃ śubhagtsarvarthakāraṇam annapuṣpaṃ mahāvāśyaṃ dakṣiṇārādhanottamam ambātmabīja paramaṃ tasmādannamudāhṛtam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena anne naiva prapūjayet gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayet samuccarannāmamantramabhiṣiñcecchanaiḥśanaiḥ dhyātvā samuccarannāma gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dāpayet pūṣeti mantrau dvau sarvaṃ sarvatrāpi samuccaret pūrvavat saṃskṛtaṃ toyaṃ hemapātre prapūritam

tajjalasya tu madhyasthaṃ sthāpayed dakṣiṇeśvaram gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayet sarvasiddhikaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvaroga vināśanam īleśannaśca kadrudrannamaste sadasasyatiḥ aghora tatpūruṣo vāma sadyasvādiṣṭayā tataḥ yedevānna āmāno gaurīṃ devāha vaipi ca omityetadbṛhatsāmaṃ bibetāpraṇavādikam pṛthak pṛthak sakṛjjaptvābhiṣiñcecchanaiśśanaiḥ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tathā tāmra samudbhavam athavā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi snānapātraṃ praśasyate āḍhakāpūrṇamadhamaṃ sarvamevāḍhakaṃ bhavet sūtreṇa veṣṭayet sarvaṃ gavākṣa sadṛśāntaraḥ āḍhakaṃ tadardhaṃ vā kalaśānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak sakūrcānvastrasaṃyuktān saratnān sthaṇḍile sthitān kalaśasya mukhe raudraṃ madhye mādhavadaivatam gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca hṛdayena pradāpayet arūpamapi rūpasthaṃ dakṣiṇadvāramīśvaram pūjāsthāna dvayaṃguhyaṃ dakṣiṇālayamadbhutam nāmamantraṃ samuccārya triyakṣaramanusmaran śuddhatoyena saṃpūjya **(?) drālepanaṃ tathā gandhodakaistataśśuddhairabhiṣiñcecchanaiśśanaiḥ pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ tatkāle tu pradāpayet liṅgapīṭhaṃ sthalaṃ caiva vasanaṃ tatpraveśayet vāstoṣpatīti mantreṇa vāstunāthaṃ samarcayet sūkṣmavastraṃ tu saṅgrāhya bandhīyāddhṛtayāṇunā

īśānādi ca sadyāntaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ vinyaset kramāt tadante darpaṇaṃ dadyāt śaktimantraṃ samuccaran tataśchatraṃ cāmaraṃ ca hṛdayena pradāpayet puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet paścāt namaskārākhyamudrayā jvālāpātrāṇi śirasā hastābhyāṃ ca nivedayet hemakumbhasthitajale dīpaṃ pūrve tu nikṣipet puṣpāñjaliṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japalakṣaṇamucyate mānasaṃ caiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhmupāṃśuṃ vyaktameva ca prātarusāgye tathābhyarcya madhyāhne ca nivedayet ekadīpaṃ dvikāle ca rātrau dīpadvayaṃ bhavet sāyecāsyāṃtamabhyarcya dīpaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ bhavet dīpaṃ caiva catuḥproktāssāye tu dviguṇaṃ bhavet prasthadvayaṃ dvikāle ca dīpaṃ viṃśatikaṃ bhavet trikālaṃ baliliṅgena balidānaṃ nayedbudhāḥ ardhayāme tadardhaṃ ca caturviṃśatidīpakam trikāle valisaṃyuktaṃ puṣpānnākṣata vai kramāt madhyāhne nityahomasyāddhūpadīpa samanvitam trikālañca nivedyaṃ ca pañcāṃśaṃ dīpasaṃyutam uttamādadhamaṃ tatra trikālandroṇamāharet trikālamannaliṅgaṃ syāt trikālaṃ homasaṃyutam aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā śataṃ vā rudrakanyakāḥ madhyamā madhyamaṃ tatra trikāle tu caturhaviḥ droṇena śuddhamannaṃ ca pacitvā tu pṛthak pṛthak trikāle balihomaṃ syāt śītārī dhūpamādiśet gaṇikāṣṭa śatopetaṃ stotra dhvanisamākulam

uttamottamamuddiśya haviṣyaṃ kramamucyate tadardhamardharātraṃ tu dīpāḥ pañcaśataṃ śubham trikālaṃ balihomaṃ syāt sarvavādya samanvitam evaṃ navavidhaṃ proktaṃ pāyasādi śṛṇu kramāt taṇḍulādviguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutam pāyasānnamidaṃ proktaṃ kṛsarānnaṃ tataḥ śṛṇu taccaturthāṃśamājyaṃ tu pācayitvā yathāvidhi ardhabhāraṃ gulaṃ kṛtvā bhārārdhaṃ vātha taṇḍulam ghṛtadroṇārdhamardhaṃ vā śṛṇu pācakalakṣaṇam śvetayajñopavītaśca śuklavastradharaśśubhaḥ bījamukhyena mantreṇa śodhayitvā vicakṣṇaḥ śikhayā jvālayedagniṃ astreṇaitān pratāpayet nirīkṣyanetramantreṇa pakvaṃ caiva caruṃ tataḥ tatpūruṣeṇa mantreṇa supakvaṃ tu parīkṣayet ekāṅgulaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ bhasmanā nyaset pātrāṇi ca tathā sarvamindhaṃ caiva supūjayet maṇṭape paścime bhāge nyasenmantrī yathākramam sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ athavā kadalīdalam sthūlī pādatrayaṃ kṛtvā tripādī madhyamasthitam sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam haviṣādriṃ samudgaṃ ca naivedyaṃ syāt śivasya tu phalaissarvopadaṃśaiśca gavyenājyena saṃyutam badhnīyāt saurabhīṃ mudrāṃ hṛdayārṇaṃ samuccaran caturbhāgaikabhāgena parivāra balirbhavet caturbhāgaikabhāgena pātraśeṣamihocyate

punarācamanaṃ datvā sugandhena jalena ca phalebhya striguṇaṃ patraṃ dāpayet tailasaṃyutam sarvadravyaviśeṣaṃ tu dadyāt caṇḍeśvarāya ca paśubhiśca gajairbhojyaṃ prakṣipet salileṣu vā yathā svasya gurocchiṣṭaṃ bhojyaṃ tat putraśiṣyayoḥ ete ekādaśāḥ proktāḥ garbhāvaraṇa śaktayaḥ anantādi śikhaṇḍyantaṃ prāgdalādi kramānnyaset ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍinaḥ ṭaṅkatriśūlamabhayaṃ vahantovarameva ca aruṇaṃ cāñjana prakhyaṃ kramādvidyeśa varṇakam śrutirmedhā tathoṣṭau ca vidyeśānāṃ tu śaktayaḥ uttare tu yajedgaurīṃ vṛṣabhaṃ pūrvato yajet mahākālaṃ tu naiṛtyāṃ bhṛṅgīśaṃ vāyugocare dvinetrā dvibhujā śyāmā gaurīkaradhṛtotpalā gajānana triṇetrastu kuṅkumābhaścaturbhujaḥ caturbhuja triṇetrastu japākusumasannibhaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaśrīmānvajracāre ca dhārakam khaḍgaṃ savajramabhayaṃ vahaṃtomarameva ca dhūmravarṇaṃ tu bhṛṅgī **(?) yeddussvapnanāśanam nīlavarṇo bhayavaro vibhracchūlaṃ paraśvatham netradvādaśakopeto vibhradvādaśabāhubhiḥ ghaṇṭāṃ ca śikhinaṃ kheṭaṃ ghaṇṭaṃ nāgaṃ tathāṅkuśam bhadrā ca vedadhānā ca kuntikāpī ca mantikā gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ loke"ṣāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu yamaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yāmye khaḍgaṃ niṛtiṃ saṃyajet

vāyumaṃśalahastaṃ ca vāyavyāndiśi pūjayet īśānamīśadigbhāge śūlahastaṃ prapūjayet śvetavarṇaṃ ca dhūmraṃ ca lokeśānāṃ kramāt prabhāḥ vṛṣabhaśca kramādaṣṭau vāhanāni ca digbhṛtām kālakaṇṭhī ca nīlī ca jitakānistu devikā lokeśāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ saurāvaraṇamucyate sarasvatī ca jyeṣṭhā ca viṣṇuśca kṣetrapālakaḥ sphaṭikaṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ tu śyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaprabhāḥ kramāt sāvitrī caiva kalyāṇī jñānī cānādadāyinī sauramāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ mayāstrāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu gadātriśūlaṃcakraṃ ca padmaṃ caivada daśāyudham śeṣāśca puruṣākārā ekavaktradvibāhukāḥ padmarāgaṃ pravālaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ ca raktakam nīlinī sumukhī caiva marddanī bhṛṅgamālinī astrāvaraṇamityuktaṃ dalādhastāt prapūjayet brāhmīmāheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā vīrabhadraṃ ca vighneśaṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi pūjayet sarvabhūtapiśācebhyo balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet antarhārāsu madhye tu vāhanaṃ pīṭhamucyate madhyādiṣu pratiṣṭhesu gaṇapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet gandhapuṣpodanairyuktaṃ dhūpadīpasamanvitam mahāpīṭhercanaṃ kṛtvā sarvadevagaṇānvitam yakṣāśca rāṣasāścaiva nāgabhūtāḥ piśācakāḥ anāvaṣṭirgaṇāścaiva rohiṇī gaṇarāva ca devadānavagandharva pīṭhamadhye prajāpatiḥ

vṛṣaṃ tu pūrvadigbhāge dakṣiṇeśaṃ tu dakṣiṇe gajādyairarcayitvā tu baliṃ sarvatra dāpayet prajāpatestu devānāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ ca yathākramam mārjanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā punarabhyarcanaṃ śubham muṣṭimātraṃ tadardhaṃ vā baliṃ sarvatra dāpayet agnikāryavidhiṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhiphalapradam tisroretā pūrvamukhyo brahmaviṣṇuharādhipāḥ sūryakāntodbhavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ araṇyudbhavameva ca sauvarṇe rājane tāmre satpātre mṛṇmayethavā śodhayedastramantreṇa kavacenāvakuṇṭhayot kuṇḍevā sthaṇḍilevāpi sapuṣpaṃ viṣṭaraṃ nyaset tasya madhye samāvāhya vāgīśīyāgakāriṇīm paścānmaheśvaraṃ devaṃ triṇetraṃ ca caturbhujam saṃhṛṣṭaṃ sahavāgīśīṃ devyā tatrāpi bhāvayet agnisthābhimukhaṃ yonau devāssadyāssamuccaran paścāt saptāhutiṃ kuryāt hṛnmantraṃ samyaguccaran puṃsavane tu śirasā saptadhā homamācaret nāmakarmavidhāne ca hṛdā saptāhutiryajet caulakarmavratavidhau hṛnmantreṇa ca saptadhā vivāhāya ca hṛnmantraṃ saptadhā homayedguruḥ evaṃ kramāttu homena śivāgnerjātakaṃ śubham agramagreṇa saṃspṛśya madhyaṃ madhyena saṃspṛśet ajyasthālīṃ carusthālīṃ praṇītāpātrameva ca praṇītāṃ pūrayettoyaiḥ tatra kūrcaṃ ca nikṣipet ājyena pātramājyasa pūrayitvā sakūrcakam

paścime uttare caiva ājyasthāpanamācaret nirīkṣaṇaṃ ca netreṇa paridhi sthāpanaṃ kuru indrādīśānaparyantān paridhisthān prapūjayet ekarūpaṃ dvivaktraṃ ca catuśṛṅgaṃ dvināsikam sopavītaṃ jaṭamauliṃ saptajihvābhirāvṛtam atiriktā bahurūpā jihvā saptaprakīrtitāḥ raktā tathottare bhāge kṛṣṇāyāmyadiśisthitā aiśānye bahurūpā ca jihvāsthānaṃ prakīrtitam agnidevasya madhye tu sādākhyaṃ supratiṣṭhitam pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpakam samidhā hṛdaye naiva aghoreṇa caruṃ hunet vāmamantreṇa saktuṃ ca kṣīraṃ **(?)dyamantrataḥ tilamīśānamantreṇa mudgaṃ māṣaṃ hṛdaṃ tathā japtvaṃ śataṃ varṇamantraṃ odanena tu homayet pañcāvarṇa devānāṃ ekahomaṃ pṛthak pṛthak tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet paścāt gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ pradāpayet agnerāliṅganaṃ nityaṃ vidadhyācchivarūpiṇam lalāṭe bāhuhṛdaye vekāṅgulaṃ tripuṇḍrakam mūlaṃ trikoṇa madhye tu sthāpayedagnidevatām koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ dhyāyennādātmakaṃ naṭam agnikāryakramam proktaṃ nityotsavavidhiṃ śṛṇu sarvasiddhikaraṃ śuddhaṃ sarvapāpaviśodhanam yakṣarākṣasapaiśācabhūtānāgāstathaiva ca dakṣiṇe maṇṭapādbhāge caturaśraṃ tu maṇḍalam sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kāṃsyaṃ vā pātramucyate

tatrāṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca kārayedvyaṅgulonnatam evaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣeṇa pātraṃ tu maṇḍalaṃ nyaset puṣpaliṅgaṃ tu pūrvāhne sāyāhneḥ taṇḍulātmakam uttamaṃ cāḍhakaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ tu tadardhakam nāpakvaṃ nātipakvaṃ ca nātyuṣṇaṃ nātiśītalam utsedhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ mūlaṃ tadviguṇaṃ bhavet madhyamaṃ dvādaśāṅgulyaṃ ūrdhvaṃ tu tryaṅgulaṃ bhavet saṃpūjya vidyāvaraṇaṃ devadhyānakramaṃ śṛṇu akṣasūtraṃ triśūlaṃ ca bibhrāṇāmabhayaṃ varam padmamudrāṃ namaskāraṃ śāntimudrāṃ prakalpayet daśāyudhāni paritaḥ kalpayet kalpavittamaḥ triśūlaṃ pūrvato gacchet śivadaṇḍātvanantare pavitrapāṇi maunī tu hastamātreṇa daṇḍadhṛk pūrvāhne brahmaprītiṃ ca madhyāhne tu śivapriyaḥ pūrvoktaṃ brahmavarṇam tu rudravarṇaṃ tu kathyate madhyāhne dhārayelliṅgaṃ mama prītikaraṃ śubham sāyāhne dhārayelliṅgaṃ viṣṇuprītikaraṃ śubham tanmūrdhniṃ deyaṃ saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajet athavā pādagamanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kārayet kāhalaistālajaṃghaiśca vīṇāveṇuravaistathā gaṇikānṛtta saṃyuktaṃ divyageya samanvitam vedadhvanisamāyuktaṃ divyanṛttasamanvitam ādyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt bhṛṅga tālasamanvitam tāladvayasamāyuktaṃ vedadhvaniniṣevitam samastaṃ bhṛṅgiṇī tālaṃ kartṛvādyaṃ tu ṭaṅkarī

bāhyapīṭhe kramāvṛtya prāsādaṃ triḥpradakṣiṇam navatākaṃ nāgatālaṃ koṭikāṃsaṃ kariṣya ca ityete kalpitāścaiva prāsādaṃ triḥpradakṣiṇam hṛdayaṃ mantramuccārya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet pratimaṃ pratiliṅgantu pūjayet pūrvavacchubham pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ namaskuryāccamudrayā pradakṣiṇaṃ duḥkhaharaṃ somasūtraṃ na laṅghayet pradakṣiṇasamaṃ nāsti pratyakṣaphalasiddhidam dvibhedalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara chāyādhastāt prakartavyaṃ vimāne tu pradakṣiṇam na doṣamanyakāleṣu chāyāsūtraṃ na laṅghayet śivaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ śaṃbhoḥ jagadrakṣārthakāraṇam āyurbalaṃ tathārogyaṃ apamṛtyu jayo bhavet pradakṣiṇe vimānānāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate jñānārthaṃ ca jayārthaṃ ca vaśyārthaṃ ca dhanārthakam aṇimā guṇimārthaṃ ca pradakṣiṇamihocyate dakṣiṇe dvāradevaṃ tu naṭeśvara manusmaret śirohastau ca karṇau ca cibukaṃ bāhuyugmakam śiro hastau dvibāhū ca kṛtvā jānu ca saṃsthitau tadante tāṇḍavaṃ kṛtvā mamaprītikaraṃ śubham liṅgamāliṅganaṃ kuryāt jñānamudrāmanantaram baliliṅgaṃ tatobhyarcya bāhyapīṭhe tu nikṣipet kauśikaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā sāyāhne cendulaṃ śubham apamṛtyu praśamanam āyurārogyavardhanam dānakṣapaṇayogena dīkṣācetyabhidhīyate

gaṅgātīre saritpuṇye samudre cāśramepi ca parvatāgre vane goṣṭhe śrīpurekṣīravṛkṣake devālaye viśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇadvāraveśmani dīkṣāsthāna kramaṃ proktaṃ dīkṣākālavidhiṃ śṛṇu ayane viṣuve caiva grahṇe somasūryayoḥ sumuhūrte sulagne ca dīkṣākarma samācaret guṇayuktāṃstu saṅgrāhya guṇahīnānvivarjayet pūrvavadvidhisaṃyuktaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥ pūrvavadbhūmi saṃśuddhiṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapamaṇḍanam śvetavarṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu bhūbhṛtāḥ ājyagandhaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ raktagandhakam madhuraṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca tiktaṃ ca kaṭukaṃ kramāt varṇagandharasairevaṃ saṃyuktaṃ yāgabhūtalam vitānadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ darbhamālā vibhūṣitam kramukaiḥ kadalībhiśca muktādāmābhirāvṛtam sudhayā bhasmanāvāpi kṛtamekhātrayāvṛtam sumitaṃ ca susūtraṃ ca kṛtvā śaṅkuṃ ca sarvataḥ utsedhā dvādaśāṅgulyāstadardhaṃ nāhasaṃyutāḥ pūrvāgrāhyuttarāgrāṇi sūtrāṇyāsphālayet kramāt sūtraṃ prasārya kṛtvā tu vartale maṇḍale śubhe karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena kesaraṃ caruṇena ca padmahastapramāṇaṃ tu karṇikā caturaṅgulam pratidvāreṇa rekhāsu padmabāhye trayaṃ bhavet padmānte prativāre tu madhye varṇakramaṃ śṛṇu paścimeśvetavarṇaṃ syāt uttare kāñcanaprabham

vāyvyāṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ syāt aiśānyāṃ śvetavarṇakam caturdvārādivarṇaṃ tu kramādvakṣye maheśvara haritena tu bāhyena trivarṇaṃ ca kramānyaset śāligodhūmapiṣṭaiśca muktācūrṇasumiśritam āgneye pītacūrṇaiśca nīlacūrṇayametathā muktācūrṇaṃ paścime ca vaidūryaṃ cūrṇamānile dhātuśca puṣpayoniśca brahmapuṣpaṃ ca utpalaiḥ haridrāśālivarṇaṃ ca madhyādīśānavarṇakaiḥ kalpaṃ bilvaṃ śamīṃ caiva vaṭavṛkṣaṃ ca caṃpakam ṣoḍaśaṃ caiva dvātriṃśat catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaraṃśatam sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā ṣoḍaśa dvādaśāṣṭavā pañcaviṃśati dvātriṃśat sahasraṃ vā śatāṣṭakam maṇḍalaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ tato hastavidhiṃ śṛṇu yūkāṣṭakayavāṣṭaṃ ca aṅgulyaṣṭa dvitālakam ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vā hastānāṃ viṃśatiṃ caiva pañcaviṃśati hastakam maṇḍalaṃ tu kṛtaṃ pūjya tasya madhye śivārcanam gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ caiva pradāpayet apūpaṃ tu phalaṃ kṣīraṃ astramantreṇa dāpayet nivedayet caruṃ samyak tadardhantu nivedayet dantairaspṛśya vidhivat pañcabrahma manusmaran tadante mantramuccārya śiṣyakarṇe tu dakṣiṇe triyambakaṃ śataṃ japtvā badhnīyāt kautukaṃ puraḥ strīṇāmapi ca śūdrāṇāṃ amantraṃ vāmahastake bhasmaśayyā samārūḍhaṃ śivadakṣiṇapārśvake

tatkāle gururūpaṃ tu dhyātvā dakṣiṇanāyakam sasūtraṃ ca savastraṃ ca saratnaṃ pūrvavat kṛtam puruṣādi ca vāmānta pūrvādyuttarato nyaset hṛdayaṃ mantramuccārya naivedyādiṃ ca dāpayet śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi duṣṭasvapnanivedayet prakṣālya pādau hastau ca samācamya vidhānataḥ athavā navavastreṇa kārpāsavihitena vā uttarābhimukho **(?) badhnīyāttu samāhitaḥ īśānena tu mantreṇa puṣpāñjalimupāharet yasminvastre patetpuṣpaṃ nāmātmaṃ tu tadātmakam śaivatatvaṃ ca kālaṃ ca mūrtī śaktikramācchṛṇu rudraṃ vāmamahaṃkāro navadhānāma kathyate sadyādiranulomasya "ṣaktyantaṃ nāma bhāṣayet agastyagautamo vasiṣṭhāḥ parāśaraścaivaromaśaḥ bindusūtraṃ viṣṇusūtraṃ paścādvāyavyasūtrakam śivaḥ śikhānandajyotsnā sāvitrisadguṇaḥ kalpo bilva śamī caiva vaṭavṛkṣaśca campakam māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ caiva puṣparāgaṃ ca nīlakam sphāṭikaṃ caiva ratnāni navadhā kīrtitāni ca anādi śaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ anuśaivaṃ caturthakam saptamaṃ bhedaśaivaṃ syāt aṣṭamaṃ guṇaśaivakam śivatatvaṃ vahnitatvaṃ śaktijñānamayaṃ tataḥ proktāni navatatvāni kālannava śṛṇu kramāt saṃhārakāle rudrastu bhogakāle maheśvaraḥ dhvanikāle tu nādātmā ājñākālestu śaktayaḥ

śivamūśśaktimūrtiṃ nādātmā bindumūrtikaḥ martayo navadhā proktāḥ śaktīrapi tataḥ śṛṇu jñānaśaktirjayāśakti yogānandākhyaśaktikāḥ nāmādi bhedāssaṃproktādvāravarṇakramaṃ śṛṇu pūrvadvāraṃ praśastaṃ tu brāhmaṇānāṃ maheśvara śūdrāṇāṃ paścimadvāraṃ viśeṣaṃ tu maheśvara pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṅgaiśca pūrvavannyāsamācaret mūlamantraṃ sakṛjjaptvā śiṣyamūrdhni nirīkṣayet saṃśrāvya samayaṃ samyak devadevasya cāgrataḥ ācārya jyeṣṭhaliṅgānāṃ chāyāmapi na laṅghayet nirmālyaṃ tu na bhuñjīta bhasmayuktānna nindayet evaṃ saṅgrāhya samayān paścāddhoma samācaret śabdasaṃrodhana sthānaṃ karṇendriyamiti smṛtam nīra***(?) karṇaṃ tu cakṣu prāṇe sujihvake samayendriyamānena ahaṃkārenalendriyam pañcabījakaraṃ nyastvā pūrvendriya nyaset kramāt evaṃ nirudhya vidhivat karṣayecchivaśaktibhiḥ sudhayā plāvayet tatra vāruṇyena śivena ca sūryamaṇḍalasaṅkāśaṃ madhyabījaṃ pratiṣṭhitam śivatatvamitiprakhyaṃ mantrarājānamavyayam pūrvamevaṃ sakumbhitvāt paścācchiṣye niyojayet indranīlamaṇiprakhyaṃ pañcaviṃśātmarūpakam ādyanta śūnyamadhyasthaṃ ānandamamṛtātmakam paravastu svarūpaṃ ca paramānandarūpiṇam aṣṭamādyā mamadhvaṃ syāt mudgasya pratiṣṭhitam

sadāśiva śivātmānam ṣaḍadhvātmā sulakṣitam mantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanādhvakam pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca pārthivaṃ tu nivṛttāvai brāhmaṇāñcaiva kathyate tejo vidyā ca tejo vai yāvadrudrasvarūpakam śāntyātītaṃ khakārātmā sādākhyaṃ tatvamavyayam vidyāsthānaṃ tu karṇāntaṃ mukhāntaṃ śāntigocaram nivṛttau sadyamantraṃ syāt pratiṣṭhāyāṃ tu vāmakam īśānamantrotītāyāṃ tanmantrairjuhuyāt tataḥ pañcatriṃśacchataṃ hutvā pañcahomamaṃ praśasyate anye vandhavināśāya hṛdayena śataṃ hunet varṇamantraṃ samuccārya ekahomaṃ praśasyate ākarṣayettu tatsarvaṃ pāśabandhavināśanam chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ ca tanyūnāṃ pāśabandhanamucyate pradāpayettu yatkāle śivamantramanusmaran vidyeśvarāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ āhutyaṣṭakamiṣyate lokapālaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ caiva homayet pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca vākpāṇi ca pādau ca pāyūpasthau ca pañcakam manobuddhirahaṃkāraḥ prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathā śuddhavidyā śuddhakalā tathā paścāt sadāśivaḥ evaṃ tatvāni ṣaṭtriṃśat svasvasthāne niyojayet kālāgni rudraṃ prathamaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhe niyojayet aṣṭāviṃśati koṭyaṃ tu narakāditidāruṇaḥ rauravaṃ kubhighoraṃ ca mahāghoraṃ ca rauravam

kantupūtaśca taptaśca asthitālavaśaṃ tathā śvānasūkaravyāghraṃ ca siṃha caiva gajendrakāḥ kṛkamaścañca kāmāśca kukkuṭaścaiva gardabhaḥ nīlayantrā ca yantrāśca cakrayantrāḥ subhīrukāḥ talaṃ ca vitalaṃ caiva talaṃ vasutalaṃ tathā ūrumadhye nyaset paścāt kramāt pātālasaptakam janalokaṃ tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ yathākramam aindraṃ brāhmaṃ ca bhuvanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudrameva ca bhūlokaṃ śivalokaṃ ca galādūrdhvaṃ prakalpayet mūlaprakṛti bījaṃ tu mukhaṃ madhye pravinyaset nāsāgre hṛdaye guhye dehamadhye tu vinyaset nivṛtti hṛtpradeśe ca pratiṣṭhā karṇagocare itthaṃ kalā ca dhvānaṃ śivatatvaṃ tataḥ param rasabandhaṃ tathā tāmraṃ na bhūyastā bhṛtāṃ vrajet evaṃ samyak tataḥ kṛtvā dīkṣā nānādivarjitā hṛdayena carutsaṅghaṃ aghoreṇa caruṃ tataḥ hṛdayena gulaṃ paścāt phalaṃ ca śivamantrataḥ yavā hṛdayamantreṇa siddhārthaṃ sadyamantrataḥ dravyābhāṣe tu sarveṣāṃ ājyahomaḥ praśasyate homānterabhiṣekaṃ ca vakṣyate tu śṛṇu kramāt śatāṣṭa kalśairvāpi sarvadravya samanvitaiḥ pañcaviṃśatitaḥ kṛtvā athavā navapañcavā pūrvavat sthāpya kalaśaṃ śivaṃ pūrvavadācaret tatpadmamadhye śiṣyaṃ tu sthāpayeduttarānanam ṛgvedaṃ pūrvadigbhāge yajurvedaṃ tu dakṣiṇe

vinyasedghoṣayet paścāt śaṅkhakāhakanisvanaiḥ vīṇāveṇuravaiścaiva nṛttagāna samanvitaiḥ śaivaiḥ pāśupataiścaiva mahāvratatarairapi vasanāsanadaṇḍādyai bhojane **(?)toṣitaiḥ abhyarcya pūrvavat kṛtvā nyāsaṃ tasya yathākramam niṣkalantu yathācāryassakalaṃ ca tathā bhavet ācāmaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā gandhapuṣpairalaṅkṛtam hārakeyūrakaṭakakuṇḍalābharaṇojvalam candanāliptasarvāṅgaṃ puṣpamālādyalaṅkṛtam sapavitra karābhyāṃ tu dhārayettoya puṣpakam praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau śirasā bhaktisaṃyutam śaṅkhakāhala saṃyuktaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭi samanvitam paścāt prāsādamuccāryavaradaṃ dakṣiṇātmakam śiṣyasya dakṣiṇe karṇe śivamantraṃ samuccaret pūjāpādamidaṃ jñānaṃ prajñāpādaṃ padaṃ vade karmātmakaṃ ca śaivaṃ ca mamā prākṣi kathaṃ prabho ācārya jyeṣṭhaliṅgānāṃ chāyāmapi na laṅghayet adīkṣitākṛtiṃ spṛṣṭvā śivamantra manusmaret mama rūpaṃ sadā dhyātvā śivamantraṃ sadā japet śivārcanaṃ tathā dharmaṃ japaṃ dhyānaṃ ca kārayet traivarṇiko viśeṣeṇa sarvakālaṃ tu dhārayet namaskārādi svāhāntaṃ kṣatriyaṃ mantramucyate namo vaṣaṭ śūdrāsya praṇavādi vivarjayet na jātibheda varṇāśca nnirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padam nirvāṇadīkṣā vakṣye tava snehācchṛṇu kramāt

aṣṭādalaṃ padmākhyastvā madhye kuṃbhaṃ pratiṣṭhayet aṅkurārpaṇa pūrve tu sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutam gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca pūrvavat pūjayet kramāt atha vārādi tīre vā karābhyāmabhiṣecayet dakṣiṇāmukhamāśritya sāsanaṃ caiva pūjayet tṛtīyaṃ dṛṃhaṇaṃ kṛtvā caturthaṃ tu vadābhayam dakṣiṇaṃ mukhamāśritya sanmārgaṃ caikathyate putravat svīkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tadante śivasaṃyutam dāsamārgaṃ viśeṣaṃ tu mama rūpaṃ tu tatsamam sanmārgaṃ sakhamārgaṃ ca putramārgaṃ ca sādhakam tasmādvedāsamārgaṃ tu nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padam tasmādācārya rūpaṃ tu mahaṃ devātmarūpakam tasmāddevamidaṃ guhyaṃ dhyāyayet paramāṃ gatim śvānayoniśataṃ prāpya caṇḍāleṣvapi jāyate ācāraṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ ca gururātma prapūjayet kecidyadi ca nityānta nṛttā kecittu yanti ca nayana dīkṣāṃ tu saṃproktaṃ sparśadīkṣāṃ tataḥ śṛṇu tatkāle mṛtarūpaṃ tu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati sparśadīkṣāvidhiṃ proktaṃ vācakaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu yasyākṣarasvarūpaṃ tu dīkṣā dhyānakramaṃ kramāt agnikāryeti sarvaṃ ca manasā kalpayecchubham mama dattamidaṃ sarvaṃ kāmaṃ mama vanaṃ vidhiḥ dīkṣāmārgakramaṃ proktaṃ utsavaṃ vakṣyate śṛṇu dīkṣite sthāpane caiva snapane prokṣaṇe tathā karṣaṇe pratimākāre śilāsaṅgrahaṇe tathā

abhiṣekadinātpūrve navame saptame'thavā pālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarāvaṃ ca tridhā bhavet pālikāṣṭadaśāṃgulyamuccamātrāṅgulena tu tadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tat ṣaḍbhāgaikamoṣṭakam vistārasya tribhāgaikaṃ varttitaṃ bilamucyate vistāra sa tribhāgaikaṃ daṇḍavistāramucyate ghaṭikā ghaṭavistāra manvaṅgla suvistaram pañcavaktra samāyuktaṃ ghaṭikāṃ kārayet tataḥ pādavistāramardhaṃ tu utsedhaṃ bilasaṃyutam bhinnaṃ ca suṣiraṃ kālaṃ bhedakoṇaṃ ca nīlakam śūlī mukundadhārāśca pālikā"ṣcādhidevatāḥ prāsāda pūrve aiśānye dakṣiṇe uttare tathā madhye vyomapadaṃ grāhya lepayedabhineṣṭakṛt sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayeddhīmān aṣṭadroṇaistuśālibhiḥ sthāpayet karṇikāmadhye candrakumbhamalaṅkṛtam pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ dhyānamārgeṇa pūjayet pāyasānnaṃ dadet paścāt tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet vinyasedguṭikā dvau tu koṇeṣu ca padadvayoḥ kuśāgreścaiva darbhaiśca nicchidraṃ suṣiraṃ kuru tato menyastu tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tu viśeṣataḥ tilasarṣapamudgaṃ ca māṣaṃ śimbaṃ tu bṛṃhiṇā ācāryo vāpayedbījān prāṅmukhodaṅmukhopi vā ācāryaṃ pūjayet tatra vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥ uttamaṃ tu navāṃbhasyāt saptamaṃ madhyameva ca triyahaṃ caivamekāhaṃ ācāryo svecchayādine

utsavārambha pūrve tu kuṇḍalakṣaṇa mucyate homakuṇḍadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tādṛśaṃ mekhalānvitam utsedhaṃ tu navāṅgulyaṃ vistārasya pramāṇataḥ trimekhalāṅgulaṃ vakṣye viśeṣeṇa maheśvara aparācchaivadvyaṅgulyaṃ vistārotsedhameva ca ekāṅgulaṃ tadutsedhaṃ vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam kṛttikādyādi māse tu kṛttike kṛttikāntakam māghamāse tu māghāntaṃ phālgune cottarāntakam jyeṣṭhamāse tu mūlāntaṃ utsavānte dine śubhe pūrvabhādre mahāmāse sa puṣyabhādrāntamucyate sarvamāseṣu kartavyaṃ ādrābhaṃ syāt śivotsavam dinānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ caṇḍasya lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu prāsādānta samaṃ daṇḍaṃ prāsāda śirasāntakam ukṣasthalāntaṃ kūṭāntaṃ gopurāntaṃ tathaiva ca karṇanābhisu madhye vā bhūtamālāmathāpi vā trihastena vimānena dviguṇaṃ daṇḍamucyate pañcahastaṃ tadūrdhve tu madhyamādi ca daṇḍakam candanaṃ caiva dāruṃ ca bilvaṃ campakameva ca kundapunnāgakhadiraṃ arjunaṃ ketakī tathā caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ madhyamaṃ tu vidhīyate caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ agrametatprakīrtitam uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva tvadhamaṃ nāhamucyate uttamaṃ hastamātraṃ tu phalakāpañcasaṃyutam aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmaṃ daśāṅgula suvistṛtam hastamātra pramāṇena vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam

saptabhāgaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā * * * * * (?) kalpayet madhyamaṃ aptahastaṃ ca tvadhaṃ ṣaḍahastakam pañcatālottama * * * * * * * * * * (?) trikoṇamāyataṃ kṛtvā pucchadvayasama**(?) pucchaṃ ca vistārārdhaṃ vā dvipucchaṃ vā tripucchakam vṛṣabhasyottare bhāge gomayālepite śubhe tasyopari padanyasya vilikhedvṛṣabhādikam chatraṃ dīpadvayaṃ caiva pārśvayoścāmare tathā śvetaṃ vṛṣabharūpaṃ tu śṛṅge rakte prakīrtitam asitaṃ vāsitaṃ vāpi śubhamālekhayedvṛṣam navadhvajasamāyuktaṃ aindrakūṭagajākṛtiḥ siṃhaṃ naiṛtadeśe tu makaraṃ vāruṇe tathā aiśānyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ caiva metaddakṣiṇapārśvake viśeṣāt pañcagavyena mūladevārcanaṃ śubham yathāvibhavavistāraṃ arcayeddeśikottamaḥ dvihastasya tu vistāraṃ śālibhiścaturaṅgulam adakena tilaiḥ paścāt catuṣkoṇādi lekhayet kūrcoparinyaset kumbhaṃ varṇaṃ rājata tāmrakam sauvarṇenātha raupyeṇa kārpāsa vihitena vā gandhodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam etāni pañcaratnāni vṛṣakumbhe vinikṣipet vastreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ pradāpayet dhvajaṃ dakṣiṇatonyasya dhvajayaṣṭi tathottaram śanaiḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā ālayaṃ tu samāśrayet dhvajasthānakramaṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣvevaṃ maheśvara

dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vā hastamānamathāpi vā tatra mūrtiṃ tu daṇḍena sthāpayet tatra daṇḍakam tadutsedhaṃ tritālasyāṃ mekhaloparivinyaset utsedhasya tu vistāraṃ tadardhaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ itthaṃ vilakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt uttamottama vedikām vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā padmākāraṃ prakalpayet bhasmarekhā trayopetaṃ śvetapuṣpairalaṅkṛtam dhvaja aṣṭacāgraṃ saṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭāmālāvibhūṣitam daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa rajjubandhaṃ krameṇa tu svaramādyādibījena pūjayet tatra vāhanam ālayantu tathā grāmaṃ nagaraṃ pattanaṃ ca vai dhvajasthānaṃ samāśritya yaṣṭasthāpanasaṃyutam prāsādābhimukhaṃ kuryāt dhvajānāṃ tu nibandhanam sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam śuklamālā guṇopete śuklayajñopavītalam prokṣayedastramantreṇa pūjayitvā yathākramam tadannaṃ japaputrārthaṃ bhogarthaṃ ca maheśvara vastreṇa veṣṭayeddaṇḍaṃ darmaissāgraiśca sundaraiḥ trisandhyāṃ pūjayet paścāt pāyasaṃ dadet mahākālaṃ tu caṇḍeśo vedikādiṣu pūjayet phālakā pañcadaivatyaṃ suṣiraṃ pārvatīmayam vṛṣabhastvīśa daivatyaṃ śūlo jyotsnādhi daivatam cāmare candrasūryeśe ghaṇṭāvṛṣabhadaivatā dikṣvaṣṭāsu ca saṃsthāpya dhvanān saṃpūjayet sudhīḥ arcayet sarvadevāṃśca gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt

maṇḍapasyāgrataḥ kuryāt maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakam dalaiṣvaṣṭasya saṃpūjya navaśaktiṃ yathākramam mūlamantraṃ samuccārya praṇavena ca saṃyutam bherikā skandadaivatyā sparśanī vāyudevatā carmasūtraṃ vāsukīśaṃ valayau candrabhāskarau arcayitvā sugandhādyaiḥ hṛdayena vicakṣaṇaḥ tatpūruṣeti mantreṇa vādyakānāṃ tu tāḍayet vṛṣatālaṃ śūlatālaṃ kaṭatālaṃ vitālakam grāmasīmni balaṃ caiva brahmādīśānameva ca etaidravyairbaliṃ kuryāt devānāṃ ca svanāmataḥ āvāhanādi tīrthāntaṃ trisandhyāṃ tatra pūjayet utsavatīrthamuddiśyāpyaṅgaṃ pratyaṅgasāntakam dhvajadaṇḍādikaṃ vṛkṣaṃ baliṃ sarvapratiṣṭhitam yatra ḍokārathāṃ caiva yantraṃ raṅgāstathaiva ca yantravṛkṣā yantranaṭā yantragopturakāṇi ca vṛṣayantrā bhūtayantrā devayantrāstathaiva ca chatrāṇi nānārūpāṇi cāmarāṇi ca kārayet ālayasyaiśa digbhāge prapāṃ kṛtvāti sundarām yāgaśālāṃ tataḥ kuryāt aiśānye pāvake'thavā daśahastaṃ navahastaṃ saptahastamathāpi vā darbhamālā samāyuktaṃ vitāna dhvajaśobhitam hastamātrocchritaṃ saumyaṃ darpaṇodarasannibham ṣaḍbhidroṇaiḥ pañcabhirvā catudroṇairyathāvidhi utsavasyāti rātre tu dakṣiṇeśaṃ mahārcanam vidadhyādutsavāraṃbhe pūrvavaccāṅkurārpaṇam

kumbhalakṣaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sakūrcaṃ vastraveṣṭitam caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca śūlapāṇiṃ jaṭādharam hemayajñopavītaṃ ca navaratnāṅgulīyakam vardhanīṃ kūrcaṃ saṃyuktāṃ vāmapārśve pratiṣṭhitam abhayaṃ jñānamudrāṃ ca dadhānaṃ padmamaṅkuśam pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ ratnodakamataḥ param indrādīśānaparyantaṃ kumbhānaṣṭau ca vinyaset lohena dāruṇāvāpi daśāyudhāni kalpayet arcayettāni sarvāṇi kalaśānāṃ bahiḥ kramāt uttare cakradevaṃ tu dakṣiṇe padmadaivatam triśūlaṃ vāyudigbhāge trisandhyāṃ pūjayecchubham triyakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ devaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam hṛnmantreṇa samitsaṅghaṃ ghṛtaṃ pūruṣamantrataḥ saktuṃ vāmena mantreṇa kṣīraṃ vai sadyamantrataḥ śivagāyatrimantreṇa gulaṃ hutvā maheśvara dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ juhuyādrudrāṇāṃ nāmayakṣyate dhūmayānaṃ ca bhūtaṃ ca vasudhā ca taruḥ kalāḥ jñānapuṣpādi gītyādi saptarudrāścaturdaśa kālarudra mahārudra śivaṃ tridinamutsavakaṃ śubham śuddhānnaṃ dadhimiśraṃ laḍḍukāpūpasaṃyutam phalaṃ ca rajanīcūrṇaṃ haridrānnaṃ sa saktukam bilvapatra kuśāgraiśca śālyannaṃ sahamiśritam indravallī haridrāśca priyaṅgughṛtasaṃyutam padmapuṣpaṃ ca rajanī lājayuktaṃ ca pāyasam gulodanaṃ ghṛtopetaṃ bṛhatīphalasaṃyutam

sājyaṃ tu kṛsarānnaṃ vai nālikeraphalairyutam kṣīrānnaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutam paṃcānnāpūpasaṃyuktaṃ ajyenaparipūritam gulānnaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca śuddhānnaṃ ghṛtapūritam śuddhānnaṃ gulasaṃmiśraṃ kṣīreṇaiva tu pūritam dvādaśe'hani dātavyaṃ śivaprītikaraṃ śubham sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ mahāprītikaraṃ śubham droṇaṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam alaṅkuryādviśeṣeṇa grāmaṃ nagarameva ca kṛta saṃmārjanāḥ śuddhāḥ sevitājalabindubhiḥ patākābhiranekābhi tathākāśadhvajairapi pūrṇakumbhairanekaiśca citravastrādibhūṣitaiḥ tato'ṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt utsavārthaṃ yathā purā dhvapiñcha samāyuktaiḥ stotramaṅgakavācakaiḥ ***(?)dhāni paritaḥ sthāpayet kāñcanālayam sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaḥ soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarīyakaḥ brahmādīśānaparyantaṃ baliṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥ sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ caiva nyāsamārādhanaṃ kramāt gandhapuṣpairathāhyarcya rudrarūpaṃ tu dhārayet vrajedutsavamante tu sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam tadante gajamārūḍhāḥ tadante vājivāhanā aśvayantrāḥ tadante tu tadante gajayantritāḥ yantradevālayā madhye nṛttageyasamanvitāḥ tṛtīyastripuraghnaṃ tu caturthaścandraśekharaḥ saptamobhaikṣamūrti syāt aṣṭamaḥ kālanāśanaḥ

ekādaśastu liṅgasthaḥ dvādaśastu sadāśivaḥ rāṅge vā śibikāyāṃ vā rathevā dvirade'thavā mahāśaivāstadante tu tadante brāhmaṇāḥ kramāt tadante gāyakāḥ sarve tadante nṛttakāḥ striyaḥ yoṣidgaṇaiścaparitaḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaiḥ nānābhūta samāyuktaiḥ nānākāhaladhārakaiḥ hastadīpairyaṣṭidīpaiḥ sarvatrapariśobhitaiḥ tadante ghoṣayettatra sarvavādya samāyutam paṇavaiḥ jhallaraiścaiva vīṇākinnaraveṇubhiḥ tadante vaiśya śūdrāśca gaccheyurjapasaṃyutāḥ vṛddhābālāyuvānaśca klīvābhogabhujastataḥ ye devamanugacchanti tadgatenāntarātmanā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyuḥ indrādīśānaparyantaṃ pīṭhaṃ kalpyaviśeṣataḥ maṇṭape tu prajāpatyaṃ gopure nandidevatā rājadvāre ca śrīdevī sabhāsthāne naṭeśvarī udyāne tu mahādevī goṣṭhe caiva tu gomukhī rudrarūpā śivasthāne viṣṇusthāne tu vaiṣṇavī taṭāke candradevāstu kūpe caiva śivastathā citrasthāne tu gandharvān nadīnāṃ karuṇālayī gosthāne pārvatīṃ caiva śmaśāne tu piśācikā muta puṣpodanau puṣpaṃ saktu lājatilairapi āmraḥ kelīphalaṃ caiva kadalīphalameva ca dāridrya duḥkhaśamanaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidam śanairdevālayaṃ gatvā balipīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet

maṇṭape tu sthito devā sarvadevagaṇaissaha narttako mardakaścaiva dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitāḥ ācāryaṃ pūrvadigbhāge nṛpaścaiva tu paścime devasyāgre viśeṣeṇa nṛttageyaṃ sa tālakam bhasmaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dīpaṃ ca tvadbhutacchatracāmaraiḥ pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dadyāt puṣpaṃ ca mūrdhni ca ācāmantu tato dadyāt dhūpadīpaṃ pradāpayet tadante dāpayedbhasmaṃ darpaṇaṃ darśayet tataḥ pīṭhāgre vā vinikṣipya prākārāṇāṃ bahikṣipet utsavasyādi rātrau tu pūjayet parameśvaram pūrve tu pāyasaṃ dadyāt dakṣiṇe tu ghṛtodanam śuddhānna mūrdhvavaktre tu naivedyaṃ pañcavarṇakam pratimāṃ golakaṃ caiva triśūlaṃ yāgadaivatam pūjā homaṃ tadante tu baliṃ caiva pradakṣiṇam dīpaṃ caiva nivedyaṃ ca trisandhyāṃ vinivedayet avamṛtasya pūrve tu mṛgayātrā samācaret badhnīyāt kautukaṃ sīmāntasyāṃ rātrau viśeṣataḥ hṛdayaṃ mantramuccārya puṇyāhaṃ tatra vācayet prāsāda paścimebhāge śālibhiścaturaśrakam lūkhalaṃ musalaṃ caiva kṣālayedastramantrataḥ vinyasya vastreṇa veṣṭya gandhapuṣpādinārcayet haridrośīra kuṣṭhāśca karpūraṃ ca sapiṃchalam sadyamantraṃ samuccārya pūjayet tu maheśvaram tadante brāhmaṇāśśiṣṭāḥ tadante bhaktimajjanāḥ aṅkuraiśśobhitaṃ kuryāt gandhapuṣpasamanvitam

liṅgaṃ darpaṇaśūleṣu pratimā parivārake ācāryo nṛpateścūrṇaṃ bhaktānāṃ ca pradāpayet śaṅkhakāhalanāścaiva bheryādi dhvanisaṃyutaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ tatra saṅkalpya vasupatrāmbujānvitam śūlāduttarata sthāpya yāgadevaṃ maheśvaram pratimābhimukhaṃ kuryāt sthaṇḍilaṃ vālukāmayam sthaṇḍilasyottare deśe pātrāṇāṃ śuddhidaṃ punaḥ vajraṃ marakataṃ caiva padmarāgaṃ ca nīlakam pādyaṃ tu pūrvadigbhāge dakṣetvācamanīyakam āgneyyāntīrthapātraṃ tu naiṛtyāṃ gandhatoyakam gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva narmadā ca sarasvatī bindumadhyāt samākṛtya sthāpayedgandhavāriṣu kūrcantu nikṣipet tatra aṅgapratyaṅgameva ca gandhapuṣpādibhirdhūpaiḥ arcayitvā yathākramam ācāmaṃ puruṣeṇaiva arghyamīśānamantrataḥ ghṛtabhikṣu ghṛtasnānaṃ dadhikrāviṇṇo dadhistathā itthaṃ tatra nadīmadhye pratimāsnānamācaret mahātīrthaṃ mahāvaśyaṃ pālanaṃ śatrunāśanam paścādbhāge sthitā devagṛhe vittānanu kramāt pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śuddhadevān samarcayet kulaikaviṃśasaṃyukta śivaloke samodate rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhyarthaṃ kārayedvidhipūrvakam vināśasya tu sandhānaṃ prāyaścittamiti smṛtam pūjākāla paribhraṃśe tatsandhyā dviguṇā bhavet nivedya pāyasānnaṃ tu punaḥ kuryācchivārcanam

dvyahetryahercanāhīne pañcaviṃśati kumbhakam viśeṣādarcanaṃ kuryāt śivamantra śatāhutim pañcāśat saṅkhyayā caiva kalaśasnapanaṃ kramāt ekādaśādi pañcāntaṃ pūjāhānistu saṃbhavet pūrvavat pūjanaṃ kuryāt naivedyaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ekādaśādi pañcāntaṃ pūjāhānistu saṃbhavet pūrvavat pūjanaṃ kuryāt naivedyaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet pūjāhānau tu māsāntaṃ kalaśānāṃ śatatrayam * * * * * * * * * * (?) saṃprokṣaṇaṃ caret dvisandhyaṃ balihānau tu dviguṇaṃ cānyasandhike dvahādārabhyamāsāntaṃ balivicchadanaṃ yadi sahasrājyāhutiṃ hutvā śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśāttu śivamantraṃ śataṃ hu*(?) balibhramaṇakāle tu pratimāliṅgameva vā tatraiva kalpayeddhomaṃ athavālayamadhyame athavā pūrvavat kṛtvā śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet * * * * * * * * * * * (?)ntraṃ śataṃ hunet aṣṭottaraśataṃ paścāt mūlamantraṃ japedguruḥ punardīpaṃ samādāya kṛtvā śeṣapradakṣiṇam * * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) hīna tu utsave tu viśeṣeṇa prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇu dhvajayaṣṭi vihīne tu daṇḍavedivihīnake darbhamālāvihīne tu * * * * * * * * aṅkurārpaṇahīne tu astrayāgavihīnake kalaśasthāpanehīne kumbhahīne ca nirjale

viṣṭaraṃ paridhihīne tu vastrahīne tathaiva ca * * * * * * * (?) tu tatkāle kalahepi ca pratimaṃ yātrakāle tu patiteyāṅgahīnake pariveṣa rajanī magnidagdhau bhayaṅkarau * * * * * * * * * * * (?) ge kṛtemasi evamādi samutpanne grāmādīnāntu doṣakṛt vṛṣabhasnapanaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpena yojayet * * * * * * * (?) tu rājā durjayamāpnuyāt dhvajavedivihīne tu mantrīṇāṃ tu bhayaṅkaram rajjuhīne dhvajacchinne naṣṭe ca patite'thavā * * * * * * (?) ccaiva puṇyāhaṃ tatra vācaret ghaṇṭāhīne tu patite bālānāṃ tu kṣayaṃ bhavet ghaṇṭāmastreṇa saṃprokṣya punassandhā* * * * (?) snapanaṃ kārayecchaṃbho bherīmapi ca tāḍayet carmaṇo bhedane caiva sasyanāśaṃ vinirdiśet paścādanyaṃ parigrāhya vidhinā tāḍaye * *(?) etaicālakṣaṇairyuktaṃ tadgrāmasya kṣayaṃ bhavet śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tattatkarma samācaret pañcagavyena saṃśodhya mūlamantraṃ śataṃ ja*(?) madhye tu yāgaśālāyāṃ sthāpitāna ghaṭāyadi pūrvavadyāgaśālāyāṃ yathāvidhi ghaṭāntaraiḥ pramādādagnidagdhe ca pūrvavat kalpayet kramāt sṛksṛvasya vihīne tu janaṃ ca jvaramāritam triyambakena mantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunet mūlamantraṃ śataṃ japtvā darbhamālāṃ ca yojayet

* * * * * * * * * * (?) vyāhṛtimeva ca āyudhānāṃ vināśe tu taskareṇa bhayaṅkaram kṛtvā salakṣaṇenaiva prokṣayettu śivāṃbhasā īśa * * * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) mahāvyādhisamutpannaḥ sasyanāśo na saṃśayaḥ tatoṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt pālikādi salakṣaṇam mūrtihomaṃ tataḥ * * * * * * * * * * (?) kumbhasthāpanahīne ca durbhikṣaṃ jāyate dhruvam yāgapradīpahīne ca pramāde ca viśeṣataḥ ghoramantraṃ śataṃ hutvā * * * * * * * * (?) durbhikṣaṃ jāyate kuṇḍe vahnivicchedanepi ca samidhaṃ carulājena juhuyānmūlamantrataḥ yāgapradīpahīne ca pramāde ca viśeṣataḥ ghoramantraṃ śataṃ hutvā dīpamāropayet tataḥ itarāṅgavibhede ca punaḥ sandhānamācaret āyudhānāṃ praṇāśe tu vibhede patane'pi ca * * * (?)peṇa mantreṇa japamaṣṭa śataṃ hunet balipātre vihīne ca dhanadhānyaṃ vinaśyati balitāla vihīne ca sarvadhāvipriyaṃ bhavet * * * * * * * * (?) lakṣmīnāśo bhavedhruvam dviguṇaṃ dīpamāropya baliśeṣaṃ samācaret tadgrāmasyakṣayaṃ prokto varṇamantraṃ śataṃ hunet utsave yānahīne ca rājāmaraṇamāpnuyāt punaḥ prakramaṇe naiva kuryādgrāma pradakṣiṇam mūlabījaṃ śataṃ hutvā * * * * * * * * (?)

pūjāparyuṣitadravyaiḥ saṅkarairlliṅgamarcayet aghorāstraṃ śataṃ hutvā snāpanaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) gahīnake snapanaṃ tatra kuvīta puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ śirobāhu ca pādau ca bhinnāniyatitaṃ tyajet * * * * (?)nakaṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuru tadgrāmavāsināṃ caiva sthānabhraṃśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ snapanaṃ kārayedbimbaṃ śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet * * * (?)dūṣaṇotpattiḥ śīghraṃ saṃtyajyatacchrayam pariveṣa tu tatkāle lokasyaiśānamādiśet nīrājanavihīne tu pāvakena bhayaṃ bhavet * * * * * * * * * (?) rvākta vidhinābudhaḥ yadyamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā bījaṃ tu snāpayecchabham ūrdhvacakraṃ śataṃ hutvā yuddhāraṃbhaṃ samācaret mū * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) snapanaṃ kārayet paścāt prakuryādabhiṣecanam praṇavaṃ tu śataṃ hutvā paścādārohayedhvajam puruṣaṃ tu śataṃ * * * * * * * * * * (?) varṇamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā snapanaṃ kārayet tataḥ nyūnaṃ caiva tathā rāṣṭre grāmayornāśanaṃ bhavet pūrvoktaṃ * * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) mūlamantrārccitaṃ hutvā paścādudvāsanaṃ smaret snapanaṃ kārayecchaṃbhoścaṇḍayāgaṃ samācaret sarvaśāntikaraṃ caiva dakṣiṇeśvaramarcayet svajātyadīkṣitaṃ spṛṣṭvā bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret

caṇḍā * * * * * * * * * * * * * * (?) snānadvayaṃ tathā proktaṃ mūlamantraṃ śataṃ japet gomayaṃ tu tathā spṛṣṭvā śīghrapañcākṣaraṃ japet vyomanyāpi * * * * * * * * * (?) bhuktvā vaiśyānnamevaṃ tu sahasraṃ tu japet kramāt māsannirantare bhuṅkte tacchūdre upajāyate śūdrastrīsaṃga * * * * * * (?)ntraṃ śataṃ hunet bhuktvā tu darśanekāle śaktyā hṛnmantramuccaran laśunaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ ca cānyocchiṣṭaṃ tu varjayet jyeṣṭhācāryasya cocchiṣṭaṃ bhojayet sarvasiddhidam japitvā hṛdayaṃ mantraṃ sarvadoṣaṃ vinaśyati adīkṣitā ca bhaktiṃ ca śrutvā hṛnmantramuccaran brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ suvarṇasteyameva ca tadācārya gṛhedeśe dhyātvā dakṣiṇamīśvaram parameśajalaṃ pītvā trisandhyāṃ snānamācaret triyakṣaraṃ japennityaṃ kaṇṭhamātrodakesthitaḥ nāmamantraṃ sadā japtvā bhāṣayebjñānamudrikām sūtaka pretakāśauca kramādvakṣye maheśvara vaiśyasya pakṣataḥ śuddhiḥ śūdraśśuddhistumāsakam śudhyate tatkṣaṇājjñānī ajñānī śokahādine tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ūrdhva śaive tu dīkṣayet sarvadoṣā ca kṛtyā ca mucyate jñānamudrikām nāmamantraṃ sadā japtvā sarvadoṣāṃstu nāśayet liṅgaṃ tu sphuṭite chinne bhagnaṃ bhinne tathaiva ca gajenotthāpitaṃ vā'pi corairunmattakairapi

sahasrakalaśaṃ sthāpya saṃprokṣaṇa mathācaret mūlaliṅgamadṛśyaṃ ca navaliṅgaṃ tu pūjayet hṛnmantreṇa śataṃ japtvā paṃcagavyena prokṣaṇam pramādāccalite liṅge sthāpayet pūrvavacchubham pūrvameva kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ tasyaprākāraliṅgakam khaṇḍastuṇḍamiti proktaṃ na cotpāṭana doṣakam varṇamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā śikhamantraṃ śataṃ japet tasmāt sarvaprayatnena na pārśvasthaṃ liṅgapūrvakam rājarāṣṭrabhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ rājānaṃ tu vardhanam dusthitaṃ susthitaṃ vā'pi śivaliṅgaṃ na cālayet anyaliṅgasya calanaṃ rājarāṣṭrābhivṛddhidam bhaktānāṃ parivārāṇāṃ vastrādīni pradāpayet liṅge vivarṇaṃ saṃprāpte pratimārodane'pi vā apāmārga samidbhiśca varṇamantraṃ śataṃ japet pratimārodane caiva tatpūrve homamācaret śaṃcame iti mantreṇa ekāhotsavamācaret prāsāde patite bhinne caitya vṛkṣaphalīkṛte evamādau samutpanne rājā rāṣṭrabhayaṃ bhavet aśvattha samidhā caiva varṇamantraṃ śataṃ hunet bhūmikampe diśāṃ dāhe pratibhāskaradarśane puścamatsyasamāyoge janānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet gurustryambakamantreṇa ayutaṃ homamācaret māsapūrṇaṃ kramācchānti kuryāddoṣa nivṛttaye ratnakānyāyamutpanne prāsāde madhusaṃśrite tatpradeśādbahirnītvā pūrayecchuddhapāṃsubhiḥ

devasyāgrata aiśānye maṇṭapaṃ kalpayecchubham saptāhaṃ vā tryāhaṃ vā trisandhyaṃ homamācaret sarvadoṣapraśamanaṃ śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet śītakumbhaṃ ca vidhinā śirasordhvani dāpayet pañcagavyābhiṣekaṃ ca kuryāt pūrvoktavartmanā darpaṇaṃ calitaṃ vāpi jīrṇaṃ vā patitaṃ tu vā sthāpayedvarṇamantreṇa gṛhītvā darpaṇaṃ navam pūrvādikṣu caturdikṣu caturvedairniṣevitaḥ pañcagavyena siddhena tathā pañcāmṛtena ca haridrāmalakādyaiśca śuddhānnaṃ cābhiṣecayet prabhūta haviṣaṃ datvā tadante dviguṇaṃ smṛtam yatra śāntikṛtā tatra dhanadhānyaṃ ca vardhate rājarāṣṭrābhivṛdhyarthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ mayoditam samuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivaloke mahīyate tat kleśaṃ tu kṛtārthāya sayāti paramāṃ gatim utsave balikāle tu yaḥ kuryāt tu pradakṣiṇam sthalepuṣpaṃ jalepuṣpaṃ puṣpapādyasyamodate sa eva dhanavān śrīmān ihaloke supūjitaḥ mama pādajale snātvā tatphalaṃ samavāpnuyāt snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ bhavet nānābhoga samopetā śivaloke mahīyate vastramābharaṇādīni yo dadyāt tu viśeṣataḥ pūjyavānihalokeṣu śaivaṃ padamavāpnuyāt grāmāṇāmantapaḥ sopi vṛddhivyāmekarāḍbhavet ihaloke dīpavaddivyaḥ sārūpyaṃ ca sa gacchati

sarvadānaṃ tapo yajñaphalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ śivalokamavāpnoti pūjyamānassadāsuraiḥ śivalokaṃ tato vidyāt sāmīpyaṃ padamāpnuyāt rūpayauvanasaṃpannassarvabhogasamanvitaḥ māṣamātraṃ tu yo dadyāt svarṇaṃ rajatameva vā śuśrūṣa gurubhaktāṃ ca ācāryaṃ paravāsinam puṇyakṣayādihāgatya pṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet yato vāci na mantreṇa japtvā smṛtvā sadāśivam mālikā maṇḍapāṃ śālāṃ kṛtvā gosthānamālayam āsanāsanisadbhāvaṃ dhyātvā dakṣiṇamīśvaram yastu prāṇaparityāgaṃ kuryācchiva nimittakam dakṣiṇe ca pare pārśve śivakṣetra samīpake dakṣiṇārādhanaṃ kṛtvā sayāti paramāṃ gatim phalapākavidhiḥ proktaṃ kṛttikādīpakaṃ śṛṇu prabhūta haviṣaṃ dadyāt apūpaṃ ca pradāpayet rātrau homaṃ prakurvīta baliṃ tatraiva nikṣipet prabhāte pūjayedvidvān devaṃ dakṣiṇamavyayam triyakṣaraṃ sakṛjjaptvā nṛttageyān supūjayet hṛdayena tu mantreṇa cūrṇakarmasamācaret tasya pārśvasthitaṃ devaṃ geyanṛttādi saṃyutam mātulaṅga phalairyuktaṃ bhaktyādi vinivedayet navodakena tanmadhye triśūlaṃ snānamācaret prabhūtaṃ ca havirddadyāt pratimādīn prapūjayet evaṃ samāsataḥ proktā snapanaṃ ca tataḥ śṛṇu saṅkrāntau viṣuve caiva grahaṇe cāyane tathā
